comments.author: @Chris-k3l1v
comments.text: Hello Trace The Globe, I really enjoy your videos and the style of your channel. I’m a video editor who creates similar travel documentary content, and I’d love to help you produce more videos consistently. If you’re interested, I’d be happy to share some of my work and even edit the first few videos for free so you can see what I can do. You can reply here if you'd like to discuss it.

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: Thank you so much for reaching out and for your kind words about our channel! We really appreciate your interest in working with us. Please feel free to contact us via email and share your portfolio and some examples of your work. We’ll be happy to take a look and discuss the possibilities. 🙏

comments.text: Greetings from Türkiye🎉🎉🎉 amazing documentary 🩷💐 Türkiye is a hidden gem 🤍💐🌺 everyone should come and see 🌹🌹

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: Greetings! 🇹🇷❤ Thank you so much for watching and for the beautiful words! Türkiye truly has so many incredible places waiting to be discovered. We’re happy that our documentary helped showcase a little of what makes this country so special. Hope to see you here again for our next journey! 🌺✨

comments.author: @HelioTravel
comments.text:
Honestly, this is hands down the most breathtaking and well-crafted Türkiye travel documentary I have ever come across! 🇹🇷✨ Türkiye is easily the most stunning country in the world, and the way this film captures its soul—from the vibrant, historic streets of Istanbul and the magical landscapes of Cappadocia to the mesmerizing turquoise coastlines—is pure art. I was completely mesmerized from start to finish. Cinematic storytelling of this caliber really deserves to go viral and reach millions!

Such a masterpiece! Quick question for you—out of all the incredible regions and hidden gems showcased in this journey, which specific spot left you the most spellbound while filming?

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: Thank you so much for such an incredible comment! 🇹🇷❤ Hearing that you were mesmerized from start to finish truly means a lot to us. If we had to choose just one place, Cappadocia would probably be the one that left us the most spellbound while filming. Watching the landscape transform with the hot-air balloons at sunrise was an unforgettable experience. That said, Türkiye makes choosing just one place almost impossible! 😍

comments.author: @TheLivingGreeceProject
comments.text: We’re actually spending a night in Istanbul on our next trip to Crete, and we’re really looking forward to getting our first little taste of Turkey. Of course, one night will probably just convince us we need to come back for much longer!

replies.author: @TraceTheGlobe
replies.text: Thank you so much! 🇹🇷 We’re sure that one night in Istanbul will leave you wanting to come back for much more. There’s so much to see, taste, and experience that a single night can only be a little introduction. We hope you have an amazing time in Istanbul on your way to Crete, and we’d love to welcome you back to Turkey for a much longer stay! ❤
